description: Compare one logical record declared in two or three of Avro, protobuf and GraphQL, and report where the representations disagree. Names are matched with case and underscores set aside, since snake_case and camelCase across these formats is convention rather than disagreement. Reports a field present in one format and not another, a type class mismatch, disagreeing optionality or repeatedness, and enum symbol sets that differ. Pay 250000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

avro.description: The record as an Avro schema. An Avro schema, as a JSON object or as JSON text, at most 262144 bytes. Nothing is fetched and no registry is consulted, so the documents supplied are the whole input.

graphql.description: The record as a GraphQL type or input. GraphQL SDL, read as a documented subset: type, interface, union, enum, input and scalar definitions with arguments, wrappers and defaults. Type extensions and directive definitions are listed as not modelled. Nothing is fetched and no registry is consulted, so the documents supplied are the whole input.

protobuf.description: The record as a protobuf message. .proto source, read as a documented subset: messages, enums, fields, oneofs, maps and reserved ranges. Imports are recorded and not followed, and services, extensions and groups are listed as not modelled. Nothing is fetched and no registry is consulted, so the documents supplied are the whole input.

record_name.description: The record, message or type name to compare. When omitted, the root record of each document is used.

name: cross_format_record_crosscheck

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

consistent.description: True only when every supplied document was compared and the fields agreed on presence, type class, repeatedness, optionality and enum symbols.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

record_names.description: The record name found in each format, which is how a name mismatch becomes visible.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

title: Cross-Format Record Crosscheck
